name: libvncserver
description: LibVNCServer provides VNC server and client libraries.

user:
cmake -B build -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr \
      -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release  \
      -D BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON      \
      -D WITH_PNG=OFF               \
      -D WITH_JPEG=OFF              \
      -D WITH_GCRYPT=OFF            \
      -G Ninja .
